The '''Lucazec system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Nuiri sector/Legends|Nuiri sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lucazec/Legends|Lucazec]].
